locations: Companies that hire remote in your country
salary_note: the bar; a strong role below it is still worth a look
domains: what you have actually built, one line each
must_not: requires work authorization you don't have

fit_rubric.5: right level, right location/remote, stack overlap, salary >= bar
fit_rubric.4: one of the above slightly off
fit_rubric.2: long shot: location or level is a stretch
fit_rubric.0: does not fit (wrong country, junior, contract)

resume_flags: things the coach should remember when tailoring: gaps, short tenures, what to lead with
